lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white stripes. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, with slightly wider intervals between the final three posterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the eighth stripe from the anterior, where the line splits near the lower ventral margin.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The fourth and sixth stripes from the anterior are abbreviated, terminating mid-flank without reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior haunch, positioned between the base of the tail and the upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots align horizontally across the upper-mid thigh, forming a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Pink tongue is visible in an active state, licking the dark muzzle. A prominent horizontal white band is present on the lower neck/brisket area.
